name: Raindrop.io
description: Raindrop.io lets agents search, save, and organize the bookmarks, collections, tags, and highlights of the signed-in user. The MCP server is in beta and needs a Raindrop.io Pro plan.

prompts.text: Find my saved articles about TypeScript performance.
Which bookmarks in my Unsorted collection have no tags?
Summarize the highlights I saved this month.

apps.name: Raindrop.io
apps.description: Bookmarks, collections, tags, and highlights, over Raindrop.io's MCP server with browser sign-in.
